title: Registry
description: Root registry document. Accepted in two forms: a flat array of RegistryEntry objects, or a named-map object keyed by entry ID for O(1) lookups. The loader normalises both into the same internal map.

oneOf.title: ArrayForm
oneOf.description: Ordered list of registry entries. Duplicate IDs are a loader error.

oneOf.title: MapForm
oneOf.description: Keyed map where each property name is the entry ID. The loader verifies that the key matches data.id.

oneOf.title: EnvelopeForm
oneOf.description: Envelope object allowing a version header, global defaults, and the entry list or map.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the loader schema this file was authored against.

namespace.description: Default namespace applied to all entries in this file that don't declare their own.

defaults.description: Global defaults merged into every entry in this file at load time.
